key.name: element-size
key.summary: Max size of an element when displaying it
key.description: Anything past that length is replaced by "…" when an element is shown in the history, and newlines and tabs are shown as spaces. 0 disables the limit.

key.name: growing-lines
key.summary: Detect and replace growing lines
key.description: Copying "Here is", then "Here is an example", leaves two entries in the history. With this enabled, the second replaces the first instead.

key.name: history-name
key.summary: The name of the current history
key.description: The default name is "history"

key.name: images-support
key.summary: Save copied images to the history
key.description: Enabled by default: images are kept alongside text.

key.name: images-preview
key.summary: Show image previews in the history
key.description: Enabled by default: an image item shows a thumbnail of itself.

key.name: images-preview-size
key.summary: Size of image previews in pixels
key.description: Size of the inline image thumbnail in the history; the larger detail preview is shown on hover. Default size is 50 pixels.

key.name: close-on-select
key.summary: Close the UI after selecting an item
key.description: Enabled by default.

key.name: launch-ui
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to launch the graphical interface
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: make-password
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to mark the active item as being a password
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: max-history-size
key.summary: Max history size
key.description: Maximum number of items in history

key.name: max-memory-usage
key.summary: Max memory usage (MB)
key.description: Maximum amount of memory used to store contents

key.name: max-text-item-size
key.summary: Max text item size
key.description: Maximum size of a text item. Anything out of this boundary is ignored.

key.name: min-text-item-size
key.summary: Min text item size
key.description: Minimum size of a text item. Anything out of this boundary is ignored.

key.name: pop
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to delete the first element in history
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: primary-to-history
key.summary: Let the primary selection affect the history
key.description: Disabled by default: only the clipboard (ctrl+c) affects the history.

key.name: rich-text-support
key.summary: Save every flavour of copied rich text
key.description: Enabled by default. When disabled, only the plain text of a rich text selection (HTML and the like) is kept.

key.name: show-history
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to display the menu
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: storage-backend
key.summary: Where the history is stored
key.description: The storage backend used to persist the history: "file" keeps it in an on-disk file, "sqlite" in a per-history database (with "encrypted-file" and "encrypted-sqlite" flavours), "none" keeps nothing.

key.name: storage-backend-revision
key.summary: Last processed storage backend revision
key.description: Set by the daemon, not meant to be edited. When it falls behind the daemon's own revision, the storage migration is offered again on startup.

key.name: sync-clipboard-to-primary
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to sync the clipboard to the primary selection
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: sync-primary-to-clipboard
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to sync the primary selection to the clipboard
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: synchronize-clipboards
key.summary: Keep the primary selection and the clipboard in sync
key.description: Disabled by default: the primary selection and the clipboard are independent.

key.name: track-changes
key.summary: Track clipboard changes
key.description: Enabled by default.

key.name: track-extension-state
key.summary: Match the daemon state to the GNOME Shell extension's
key.description: When enabled, disabling the extension stops the daemon tracking as well. Disabled by default: the daemon state is left alone.

key.name: trim-items
key.summary: Trim text items before adding them to the history
key.description: Trimming removes the leading and trailing whitespace. Disabled by default: items are stored just as they were copied.

key.name: upload
key.summary: The keyboard shortcut to upload the first element in history to a pastebin service
key.description: An empty string disables this shortcut.

key.name: empty-history-confirmation
key.summary: Ask for confirmation before emptying a history
key.description: Enabled by default, because emptying a history cannot be undone.

key.name: experimental-meta-daemon
key.summary: Run the experimental in-shell (mutter) daemon
key.description: Disabled by default: the GNOME Shell extension is a pure client and the standalone daemon does the work.
